model.name: qwen3.6-35b-a3b
model.about: Alibaba Qwen3.6, mixture of experts (35B, about 3B active), FP8 as published by Qwen. Apache-2.0. Fits an A100 (about 44 GB of 80; FP8 through vLLM's fallback path there). Tests speed against the 27B dense Qwen: far fewer active parameters per token. Thinking off, as for the other Qwen profiles.

SELECT
    ch.DSPLY_NM AS channel_name,
    COUNT(*) AS transaction_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN txn
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt
    ON txn.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CHNL ch
    ON txn.CHNL_K = ch.CHNL_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY
    ch.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY
    transaction_count DESC;

SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS active_customer_count
FROM
  bank_dwh.D_CUST
WHERE
  IS_ACTV = TRUE
  AND IS_CURR = TRUE

SELECT
    j.JUR_CD1 AS jurisdiction_code,
    j.DSPLY_NM AS jurisdiction_name,
    COUNT(*) AS alert_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_AML_ALRT a
JOIN bank_dwh.D_JUR j
    ON a.JUR_K = j.JUR_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d
    ON a.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY
    j.JUR_CD1,
    j.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY
    alert_count DESC;

SELECT
    br.DSPLY_NM AS branch_name,
    COUNT(*) AS txn_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN atm
JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR br
    ON atm.BR_K = br.BR_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt
    ON atm.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY
    br.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY
    txn_count DESC;

SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS dispute_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT dspt
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt
  ON dspt.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

SELECT
    COUNT(DISTINCT d.CUST_K) AS default_client_count
FROM bank_dwh.D_DT dt
JOIN bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D d ON dt.DT_K = d.BUS_DT_K
WHERE dt.CAL_DT = DATE '2025-08-31'
  AND d.DFLT_FLG = TRUE;

SELECT
    ctg.DSPLY_NM AS complaint_category,
    COUNT(*) AS complaint_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_CMPLT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CMPLT_CTG ctg ON f.CMPLT_CTG_K = ctg.CMPLT_CTG_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY ctg.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY complaint_count DESC;

SELECT
  d_ccy.CCY_CD1 AS currency_code,
  AVG(f.FX_RT_D.AVRG_RT) AS avg_daily_fx_rate
FROM bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d_dt
  ON f.BUS_DT_K = d_dt.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CCY d_ccy
  ON f.CCY_K = d_ccy.CCY_K
WHERE d_dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY
  d_ccy.CCY_CD1
ORDER BY
  d_ccy.CCY_CD1;

SELECT
    d_mkt.MKT_ID,
    d_mkt.MKT_CD1,
    SUM(f.MKT_VAL1_AMT) AS total_market_value
FROM bank_dwh.F_PTF_VAL_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d_bus ON f.BUS_DT_K = d_bus.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_PTF d_mkt ON f.PTF_K = d_mkt.PTF_K
WHERE d_bus.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY
    d_mkt.MKT_ID,
    d_mkt.MKT_CD1
ORDER BY
    total_market_value DESC;

WITH ranked_customers AS (
    SELECT
        CUST_K,
        BUS_ID,
        BUS_CD1,
        DSPLY_NM,
        DSC,
        EFF_FRM_DT,
        EFF_TO_DT,
        IS_CURR,
        IS_ACTV,
        SRC_SYS_CD1,
        SRC_REC_ID,
        INGST_AT,
        UPD_AT,
        REC_HSH,
        DATA_QLY_STS_CD1,
        DATA_OWNR_CD1,
        VRSN_NBR,
        LGL_NM,
        GVN_NM,
        FMLY_NM,
        PRFRR_NM,
        BRTH_DT,
        INCRP_DT,
        NTNL_ID_HSH,
        TAX_ID_HSH,
        CUST_SGMNT_CD1,
        CUST_SBSGM_CD1,
        REL_MNGR_ID,
        RSDNC_CNTRY_CD1,
        TAX_RSDNC_CNTRY_CD1,
        CTY_NM,
        PSTL_CD1,
        ADDRS_LINE_1,
        ADDRS_LINE_2,
        EML_HSH,
        PHN_HSH,
        OCCPT_CD1,
        INDST_CD1,
        EMPLY_NM,
        KYC_STS_CD1,
        KYC_RVW_DT,
        PEP_STS_CD1,
        SNCTN_STS_CD1,
        RSK_BND_CD1,
        ONBRD_DT,
        CLSR_DT,
        PRFRR_LNGG_CD1,
        PRFRR_CNTCT_CHNL_CD1,
        MRKTN_CNSNT_FLG,
        PRVCY_CNSNT_FLG,
        HHLD_SIZE_CNT,
        ANNL_INCM_AMT,
        ESTMT_ASSTS_AMT,
        SRC_OF_WLTH_CD1,
        CUST_SNC_DT,
        DCSD_FLG,
        VLNRB_CD1,
        CUST_CLSSF_CD1,
        CUST_STS_CD1,
        CUST_RSK_BND_CD1,
        CUST_FMLY_CD1,
        CUST_OWNR_CD1,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY BUS_ID, LGL_NM, BRTH_DT, EML_HSH, PHN_HSH
            ORDER BY INGST_AT DESC, VRSN_NBR DESC
        ) AS rn
    FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
)
DELETE FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
WHERE CUST_K IN (
    SELECT CUST_K
    FROM ranked_customers
    WHERE rn > 1
);

SELECT
    a.ACCT_TYP_CD1,
    COUNT(DISTINCT a.ACCT_K) AS account_count
FROM bank_dwh.D_ACCT a
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON a.OPND_DT = d.CAL_DT
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY a.ACCT_TYP_CD1
ORDER BY a.ACCT_TYP_CD1;

SELECT
    d_br.CTY_NM,
    COUNT(*) AS txn_cnt
FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d_dt
    ON f.BUS_DT_K = d_dt.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR d_br
    ON f.BR_K = d_br.BR_K
WHERE d_dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND d_dt.QTR_NBR = 1
GROUP BY
    d_br.CTY_NM
ORDER BY
    d_br.CTY_NM;

SELECT
  AVG(f.CLSNG_BAL_AMT) AS avg_account_closing_balance
FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d
  ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_DT = DATE '2025-06-30';

SELECT
  AVG(f.MID_RT) AS avg_mid_rate
FROM bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CCY c
  ON f.CCY_K = c.CCY_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d
  ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE c.ISO_ALPH_CD1 = 'USD'
  AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND d.MTH_NBR = 12

SELECT
    dc.CUST_SGMNT_CD1 AS customer_segment,
    COUNT(DISTINCT dc.CUST_K) AS customer_count
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST dc
WHERE dc.IS_CURR = TRUE
GROUP BY dc.CUST_SGMNT_CD1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.CUST_K) AS customer_count
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST c
WHERE c.IS_CURR = TRUE
  AND c.IS_ACTV = TRUE
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN t
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON t.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
    WHERE t.CUST_K = c.CUST_K
      AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  );

SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN COUNT(*) = 0 THEN 0.0
    ELSE ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN fa.PMT_STS_CD1 = 'DECLINED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2)
  END AS declined_percentage
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_AUTH fa
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON fa.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

SELECT
    ctg.DSPLY_NM AS complaint_category_name,
    COUNT(*) AS escalated_complaints_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_CMPLT cmp
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt
    ON cmp.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CMPLT_CTG ctg
    ON cmp.CMPLT_CTG_K = ctg.CMPLT_CTG_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
    AND cmp.IS_ESCLT = TRUE
GROUP BY
    ctg.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY
    escalated_complaints_count DESC;

SELECT
  SUM(f.TXN_AMT) AS total_transaction_amount
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE f.DSPT_RSN_CD1 = 'FRAUD'
  AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025

SELECT
    j.DSPLY_NM AS jurisdiction_name,
    COUNT(*) AS alert_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_AML_ALRT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_JUR j
    ON f.JUR_K = j.JUR_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d
    ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_AML_SCN s
    ON f.AML_SCN_K = s.AML_SCN_K
WHERE
    d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
    AND f.ALRT_SVRTY_CD1 = 'HIGH'
GROUP BY
    j.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY
    alert_count DESC;

SELECT
    COUNT(*) AS loan_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DSBRS f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_DT = DATE '2025-08-31'
  AND f.DYS_PST_DUE > 90

SELECT
    p.DSPLY_NM AS loan_product_name,
    SUM(d.OTSTN_PRNCP_AMT) AS total_outstanding_principal
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_RPMT d
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON d.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_LN_PRD p ON d.LN_PRD_K = p.LN_PRD_K
WHERE dt.CAL_DT = DATE '2025-12-31'
  AND p.IS_CURR = TRUE
GROUP BY
    p.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY
    total_outstanding_principal DESC;

SELECT
    COUNT(DISTINCT f.CUST_K) AS distinct_sme_customers
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST c
    ON f.CUST_K = c.CUST_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d
    ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE c.CUST_SGMNT_CD1 = 'SME'
  AND f.IS_CRSS_BRDR = TRUE
  AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025

WITH branch_txn_counts AS (
    SELECT
        br.RGN_CD1 AS region_code,
        br.DSPLY_NM AS branch_name,
        COUNT(*) AS atm_transaction_count
    FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN f
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR br ON f.BR_K = br.BR_K
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
    WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
    GROUP BY
        br.RGN_CD1,
        br.DSPLY_NM
),
ranked_branches AS (
    SELECT
        region_code,
        branch_name,
        atm_transaction_count,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY region_code
            ORDER BY atm_transaction_count DESC
        ) as rn
    FROM branch_txn_counts
)
SELECT
    region_code,
    branch_name,
    atm_transaction_count
FROM ranked_branches
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY region_code;

SELECT
    m.MRCH_CTG_CD1,
    SUM(f.TXN_AMT) AS total_auth_amount
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_FEE f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_MRCH_CTG m ON f.MRCH_CTG_K = m.MRCH_CTG_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY m.MRCH_CTG_CD1
ORDER BY total_auth_amount DESC
LIMIT 3

SELECT
    c.BUS_ID,
    SUM(w.ORGNL_AMT) AS total_wire_amount
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF w
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST c
    ON w.CUST_K = c.CUST_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d
    ON w.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY c.BUS_ID
ORDER BY total_wire_amount DESC
LIMIT 5

SELECT
    d_ccy.CCY_CD1 AS currency_code,
    SUM(f_wr_trf.ORGNL_AMT) AS total_wire_transfer_amount
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f_wr_trf
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CCY d_ccy
    ON f_wr_trf.CCY_K = d_ccy.CCY_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d_dt
    ON f_wr_trf.BUS_DT_K = d_dt.DT_K
WHERE d_dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY
    d_ccy.CCY_CD1
ORDER BY
    total_wire_transfer_amount DESC;

UPDATE bank_dwh.D_CUST
SET CUST_SGMNT_CD1 = 'AFFLUENT'
WHERE CTY_NM = 'Cluj-Napoca'
  AND IS_CURR = TRUE
  AND IS_ACTV = TRUE;

SELECT
    d_ccy.CCY_CD1 AS currency_code,
    SUM(f_wr_trf.ORGNL_AMT) AS total_wire_transfer_volume
FROM
    bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f_wr_trf
JOIN
    bank_dwh.D_DT d_dt ON f_wr_trf.BUS_DT_K = d_dt.DT_K
JOIN
    bank_dwh.D_CCY d_ccy ON f_wr_trf.CCY_K = d_ccy.CCY_K
WHERE
    d_dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY
    d_ccy.CCY_CD1
ORDER BY
    total_wire_transfer_volume DESC;

SELECT
    ch.DSPLY_NM AS channel_name,
    COUNT(*) AS transaction_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN txn
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt
    ON txn.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CHNL ch
    ON txn.CHNL_K = ch.CHNL_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY
    ch.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY
    transaction_count DESC;

SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS active_customer_count
FROM
  bank_dwh.D_CUST
WHERE
  IS_ACTV = TRUE
  AND IS_CURR = TRUE

SELECT
    j.JUR_CD1 AS jurisdiction_code,
    j.DSPLY_NM AS jurisdiction_name,
    COUNT(f.AML_ALRT_F_K) AS alert_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_AML_ALRT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_JUR j
    ON f.JUR_K = j.JUR_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d
    ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY
    j.JUR_CD1,
    j.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY
    alert_count DESC;

SELECT
    br.DSPLY_NM AS branch_name,
    COUNT(*) AS txn_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN atm
JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR br
    ON atm.BR_K = br.BR_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt
    ON atm.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY
    br.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY
    txn_count DESC;

SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS dispute_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT dspt
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt
  ON dspt.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT f.CUST_K) AS client_count_in_default
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND d.MTH_NBR = 8
  AND f.DFLT_FLG = TRUE;

SELECT
    d_cmplt_ctg.DSPLY_NM AS complaint_category,
    COUNT(*) AS complaint_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_CMPLT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d_dt
    ON f.BUS_DT_K = d_dt.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CMPLT_CTG d_cmplt_ctg
    ON f.CMPLT_CTG_K = d_cmplt_ctg.CMPLT_CTG_K
WHERE d_dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY
    d_cmplt_ctg.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY
    complaint_count DESC;

SELECT
  d_ccy.iso_alph_cd1 AS currency_code,
  AVG(f_fx_rt_d.mid_rt) AS avg_daily_fx_rate
FROM bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D f_fx_rt_d
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d_dt
  ON f_fx_rt_d.bus_dt_k = d_dt.dt_k
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CCY d_ccy
  ON f_fx_rt_d.ccy_k = d_ccy.ccy_k
WHERE d_dt.cal_yr_nbr = 2025
GROUP BY

ORDER BY

SELECT

WHERE d_bus.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY

ORDER BY

FROM bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CCY c
  ON f.CCY_K = c.CCY_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d
  ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE c.ISO_ALPH_CD1 = 'USD'
  AND d.MTH_NM = 'December'
  AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025

SELECT
    dc.CUST_SGMNT_CD1 AS customer_segment,
    COUNT(DISTINCT dc.CUST_K) AS customer_count
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST dc
WHERE dc.IS_CURR = TRUE
GROUP BY dc.CUST_SGMNT_CD1
ORDER BY customer_segment;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.CUST_K) AS customer_count
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST c
WHERE c.IS_CURR = TRUE
  AND c.IS_ACTV = TRUE
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN t
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON t.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
    WHERE t.CUST_K = c.CUST_K
      AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  );

SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN COUNT(*) = 0 THEN 0.0
    ELSE ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN fa.PMT_STS_CD1 = 'DECLINED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2)
  END AS declined_percentage
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_AUTH fa
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON fa.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

SELECT
    ctg.DSPLY_NM AS complaint_category_name,
    COUNT(*) AS escalated_complaints_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_CMPLT cmp
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt
    ON cmp.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CMPLT_CTG ctg
    ON cmp.CMPLT_CTG_K = ctg.CMPLT_CTG_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
    AND cmp.IS_ESCLT = TRUE
GROUP BY
    ctg.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY
    escalated_complaints_count DESC;

SELECT
  SUM(f.TXN_AMT) AS total_transaction_amount
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE f.DSPT_RSN_CD1 = 'FRAUD'
  AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025

SELECT
    j.DSPLY_NM AS jurisdiction_name,
    COUNT(*) AS alert_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_AML_ALRT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_JUR j
    ON f.JUR_K = j.JUR_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d
    ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE j.IS_CURR = TRUE
  AND j.IS_ACTV = TRUE
  AND f.ALRT_SVRTY_CD1 = 'HIGH'
  AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY
    j.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY
    alert_count DESC;

SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS loan_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DSBRS f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_DT = DATE '2025-08-31'
  AND f.DYS_PST_DUE > 90

SELECT
    p.DSPLY_NM AS loan_product_name,
    SUM(d.OTSTN_PRNCP_AMT) AS total_outstanding_principal
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_RPMT d
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON d.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_LN_PRD p ON d.LN_PRD_K = p.LN_PRD_K
WHERE dt.CAL_DT = DATE '2025-12-31'
GROUP BY
    p.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY
    total_outstanding_principal DESC;

SELECT
    COUNT(DISTINCT f.CUST_K) AS distinct_sme_customers
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST c
    ON f.CUST_K = c.CUST_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d
    ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE c.CUST_SGMNT_CD1 = 'SME'
  AND f.IS_CRSS_BRDR = TRUE
  AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025

WITH branch_txn_counts AS (
    SELECT
        br.RGN_CD1 AS region_code,
        br.DSPLY_NM AS branch_name,
        COUNT(*) AS atm_transaction_count
    FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN txn
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR br
        ON txn.BR_K = br.BR_K
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt
        ON txn.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
    WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
    GROUP BY
        br.RGN_CD1,
        br.DSPLY_NM
),
ranked_branches AS (
    SELECT
        region_code,
        branch_name,
        atm_transaction_count,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY region_code
            ORDER BY atm_transaction_count DESC
        ) AS rn
    FROM branch_txn_counts
)
SELECT
    region_code,
    branch_name,
    atm_transaction_count
FROM ranked_branches
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY region_code;

SELECT
    m.MRCH_CTG_CD1,
    SUM(f.TXN_AMT) AS total_auth_amount
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_FEE f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_MRCH_CTG m ON f.MRCH_CTG_K = m.MRCH_CTG_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY m.MRCH_CTG_CD1
ORDER BY total_auth_amount DESC
LIMIT 3

SELECT
    c.BUS_ID,
    SUM(w.ORGNL_AMT) AS total_wire_amount
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF w
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST c
    ON w.CUST_K = c.CUST_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d
    ON w.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY c.BUS_ID
ORDER BY total_wire_amount DESC
LIMIT 5

SELECT
    d_ccy.CCY_CD1 AS currency_code,
    SUM(f_wr_trf.ORGNL_AMT) AS total_wire_transfer_amount
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f_wr_trf
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d_dt
    ON f_wr_trf.BUS_DT_K = d_dt.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CCY d_ccy
    ON f_wr_trf.CCY_K = d_ccy.CCY_K
WHERE d_dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY
    d_ccy.CCY_CD1
ORDER BY
    total_wire_transfer_amount DESC;
